name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.chains_root_lt
typeText:
∀ {d : Nat} (s : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} 1 s →
    ∀ (vs : List.{0} (List.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Letter.{0} (Fin d)))) (ρ : Nat),
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.chains s vs).2 ρ →
        LT.lt.{0} ρ (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} s (List.length.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.chains s vs).1))

source.code:
theorem chains_root_lt (s : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (vs : List (List (Letter (Fin d)))) :
    ∀ ρ ∈ (chains s vs).2, ρ < s + (chains s vs).1.length := by
  induction vs generalizing s with
  | nil => intro ρ h; simp [chains] at h
  | cons v vs ih =>
      intro ρ h
      simp only [chains, List.mem_cons] at h
      simp only [chains, List.length_append]
      rcases h with rfl | h
      · have := wordNodes_root_lt s hs v
        rw [wordNodes_length]
        omega
      · have := ih (s + (wordNodes s v).1.length) (by omega) ρ h
        omega
